description: Read which warehouses the workspace sells from: orders.warehouseIds — the list an order with no channel list takes its units from, in order (null = each product's primary warehouse); channels — each marketplace's own list, which is both what it publishes (units there minus reservations) and where its orders take units (a channel absent here publishes each product's total); platforms — the channels that accept a list; warehouses — the own warehouses and supplier showcases a list may name. Lists apply only while stockPerWarehouse is true. Read-only. Use preview_channel_warehouses then set_channel_warehouses to change a channel, set_order_warehouses for orders.
name: get_stock_sources
title: Get stock sources
